svg.title: Application internals
svg.desc: Inside the single Next.js container: the public pages and staff /edit UI (React Server Components), the API route handlers grouped by purpose — the public-data surface spans scholars, publications, topics, methods, centers / units, NIH portfolio, funding opportunities, the center-collaboration network, and capped exports — and the internal libraries they share, wired to Aurora (reader/writer), OpenSearch (five per-entity aliases), the SAML IdP, and the WCM directory (LDAP role groups + live headshots); scoped grants and the audit log live in Aurora. ISR output is shared across tasks through an S3 cacheHandler (#1503). The /edit write path calls Amazon Bedrock for AI generation (overview · biosketch · CV) and Matcha concept extraction; reads ReCiter suggestions and writes opportunity submissions and core claims to ReciterAI's DynamoDB (rejects reach the ReCiter engine through the ETL); and reflects each commit post-response — ISR revalidate, CloudFront invalidation, OpenSearch suppression. The CV path reads clinical fields live from POPS (lib/edit/pops.ts). proxy.ts (Node runtime) gates /edit and impersonation, sets CSP on every document, and 301s legacy VIVO URLs.
